sloka: यदेतद्राक्षसानीकं मेघश्यामं विलोक्यते।एतदायोध्यतां शीघ्रं कपिभिः पादपायुधैः ।। ६.८६.२ ।।
transliteration: yadetadrākṣasānīkaṁ meghaśyāmaṁ vilokyate।etadāyodhyatāṁ śīghraṁ kapibhiḥ pādapāyudhaiḥ ।। 6.86.2 ।।

translations.english: "The army of Rakshasas looks like a dark cloud and let the monkeys too get engaged to fight swiftly with trees as weapons."
